issueDispositions.rationale: Added an exact filename and exact four-sheet inventory criterion to the workbook row.
Removed the memo-only cross-dataset scope reconciliation because the instructions do not require it.
Allowed documented estimates, endpoint ranges, or quote-required treatment for unpriced required scope and required consistent propagation through TCO, scoring, award basis, and sensitivity.
Reworded source-field coverage to permit a normalized Donors and Gifts design while requiring an unambiguous gift-to-donor link.
Removed the unrequested donor-deduplication algorithm narrative while retaining the explicit volunteer-donor matching-key requirement and outcome checks.
Removed the undefined necessary-extent privacy criterion and retained objective source and judgment-call consistency checks.
Added the exact SOC101_Fall2024_Gradebook.xlsx filename requirement.
Explicitly accepts population or sample standard deviation when one convention is used consistently across components and sections.
Declared api_endpoints_data.csv authoritative for public parameter and request-body schemas when broader developer notes conflict.
Replaced subjective appropriate-tables and professional-format judgments with observable title/header and table-readability checks.
The rubric content is source-aligned; supplying normalized pump data and standards excerpts is an evaluator-context responsibility and must not be replaced with hidden expected answers.
PDF image rendering is an extraction limitation. Weakening the explicit plot requirement or substituting a hidden table exception would change the task.
Providing compact visit, financial, peer, and benchmark evidence to the judge is evaluator infrastructure; the rubric should not embed computed answers.
The red-fill requirement is explicit in the task. XLSX style and conditional-format inspection should be added to extraction rather than replaced with an unrequested flag column.
Source and purchasing-manual context plus deterministic calculation checks belong in evaluator infrastructure and should not be encoded as hidden vendor answers.
Visual flags are an explicit deliverable requirement. Workbook style rendering or inspection is needed; adding an unrequested field solely for extraction would alter the task.
The one-to-two-page limit is explicit. DOCX rendering and page counting should be fixed rather than replacing the requirement with an arbitrary word limit.
Source rows and deterministic matching and tier checks must be supplied to the judge; embedding names, counts, or expected matches would reintroduce hidden answers.
Replaced claims about being built on a template with observable filename, sheet-role, header, roster, tier, and acknowledgment-content requirements without copying hidden template text.
Attendance, leave, memo, staff, and handbook context must be passed to the judge; hard-coding employee outcomes would be an invalid rubric workaround.
Original gradebook, attendance, office-hours, essay-rubric, and external baseline evidence belong in evaluator context; fixed grades and statistics must not be added to the rubric.
Endpoint, ticket, changelog, and template evidence must be supplied to the judge. Encoding exact source facts in the rubric would recreate hidden-answer grading.
Removed subjective reasonableness and now requires a cited source or shown derivation, numeric range endpoints, or explicit Quote Required treatment with downstream handling.
Created a 2-point structural-deliverables row for all exact filenames and reduced the grade-calculation row from 10 to 8 points, preserving the 66-point total.
